# QtRocket design-corpus placement baseline: the frozen t = 0 snapshot of every committed
# fixture's integrator-facing quantities, loaded airframe-only (EMPTY motor DB; the <motor>
# element re-attaches programmatically and never perturbs placement).
#
# A diff means the resolver, the composite aggregation, or the corpus geometry changed.
# Regenerate ONLY for a deliberate change (PlacementInvariance.RegenerateBaseline, gated
# behind QTROCKET_REGEN_PLACEMENT_BASELINE=1), never to silence an unexplained diff.
#
# All stations are in the tip datum (z = 0 at the root fore plane, +z forward):
#   mass     topPart->getCompositeMass(0)                  [kg]
#   cm       topPart->getCompositeCm(0)      (x y z)       [m]
#   inertia  topPart->getCompositeI(0)       (row-major)   [kg m^2, about the composite CG]
#   cp       topPart->getCompositeAero(1).cp()  (valid cp) [m]
#   part     '<index> <type> <x> <y> <z> <name>': each part's resolved CM station,
#            DFS pre-order.
# Doubles are %.17g (exact IEEE-754 double round-trip).
#
format 2
